articles.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
articles.snippet: The crypto financial services firm is funding developers to strengthen the blockchain's security before quantum computers become powerful enough to steal billions in crypto.

articles.title: More MiCA-licensed crypto firms may exit EU market: Gate Europe CEO
articles.snippet: Gate Europe’s Giovanni Cunti says some MiCA-licensed crypto firms may struggle to sustain compliance costs as Europe enters its new regulatory era.

articles.title: XRP Breaks Out on Clarity Act Hopes. The Charts Are Still Cautious
articles.snippet: The Ripple-linked token just had its best day in weeks, as Washington may finally be delivering what the XRP Army has been waiting for.
